evidence.kind: Source-derived CPU mathematical fixtures; no Blender render performed for these four
evidence.independent_review: an independent reviewer independently recomputed source equations; not generated from builder output

coordinate_contract.source: Y-up; source vector H computations use identity view for convenience. Simultaneously rotating N/V/L to camera coordinates preserves ordinary dot products. Face uses world XZ projection.
coordinate_contract.blender_transform: C(x,y,z)=(x,-z,y); source world XZ plane becomes Blender world XY.
coordinate_contract.blender_camera: For fixture plane use normal_world and view_direction_world from each case; compare full-coverage flat interior, not silhouettes. Source identity-view bookkeeping is not a required Blender camera orientation.

fixture_rules: Use float32 linear/data images or direct float32 constants. Do not write these fixture values through PNG/JPEG, sRGB encoding, or half-float image storage before shading.

Main is deliberately linear/data for this fixture. The raw material shadow colors are source-inverse-sRGB encoded so character_material.C recovers the stated linear colors; do not decode them a second time.
Mask alpha must remain an independent channel; use CHANNEL_PACKED/Non-Color. A=.8/.7 is direction data, not material coverage. Main alpha is1.
Face texture is 2x1, sampled LINEAR at u=.25/.75 and v=.5, exact texel centers; no horizontal interpolation is intended. With height1, vertical-origin conventions do not affect the fixture.
Set UVMap constant at (.25,.5) in sampled region or sample only central pixel with that UV. If UV varies, expected H/band vary with bilinear mask filtering.
Output raw linear float32 EXR or direct node/AOV values; do not compare displayed screenshot, PNG, postprocessed RGB, or tonemapped results against finalRGB.
Use emission formula output strength1, geometry facing camera, full coverage, no unrelated occluders or shadow maps. Coverage expected1, BloomWeight0.

AOV names for current graph: HalfLambert scalar, ShadowBand color, plus rendered linear RGB. firstWeight/secondAllowed are analytical intermediate expectations if additional diagnostic taps are added by main.
All shadow colors are white to separate the non-shadow term; this does not disable the existing shadow arithmetic.
Raw material color values are inverse-sRGB representations of documented linear colors. Float texture data is linear/Non-Color; do not encode it.
Only normal/view are pinned as in existing probe. Rim case geometry must remain front-facing.
Skin 2x1 ramp tests one exact texel center, not bilinear filtering or vertical row orientation. Matcap 1x1 constant tests its mask/attenuation, not camera-space UV/YScale.
Use --skip-second-gate-on for this document: it has no second_gate_off primary fixture.

precision.reference: float64 CPU algebra from source, independently checked; no bit-exact GPU promise
precision.existing_probe_observation: Previous seven cases exhibited internal AOV quantization up to .00048828125 even with float32 EXR output and input half disabled. This is historical precision guidance, not this document being rendered.

required_probe_adaptations.change: Allow only case.enabled_modules and their exact texture/keyword/flag sets; preserve all other zero/opaque restrictions. Existing function rejects all four by design.

Extend with the independent source equations listed in each case, producing skin-modified albedo, style specular, rim and matcap before finalRGB. Do not use the production builder outputs to compute expectations.

Use expected_aovs for SkinRate/StyleSpecular/RimTerm/MatcapTerm instead of current hard-coded zero assertions; preserve BaseAlbedo as unmodified Main. Compare Image/ProbeFinalLinear to extended CPU final.
Pass --skip-second-gate-on or only add that control when second_gate_off exists; do not change the original seven-case document.
Existing float32 texture loader, runtime and vector pins are sufficient. New texture index2 supplies SkinRamp/Matcap; attributes=() and fixed-front plane are sufficient.
